naturalProof: Since s is compact and f is continuous, the image f '' s is compact by the continuous-image theorem.

description: A subgroup is closed under the group multiplication.
naturalProof: Because x and y both belong to H and H is a subgroup, their product xy belongs to H.
naturalDraft: 因此 $x * y ∈ H$，由子群乘法封闭性，使用 H、hx 和 hy
